seoDescription: 14 technology & saas use cases on monday.com, 1 with AI. See the process, boards, automations and integrations for each.
heading: Technology & SaaS use cases
intro: Every use case comes from a real Fruition client engagement, with the client's name withheld. Select "See the build" for the process diagram, boards, automations and integrations.

faq.question: What do technology & SaaS organisations build on monday.com with Fruition?
faq.answer: This page shows 14 technology & SaaS use cases. The most common are integrations & migration (10), CRM (7), work & project management (7), most often for sales & CRM, projects & PMO, customer service teams.

faq.question: How long does a technology & SaaS monday.com build take?
faq.answer: The most common timeframe for a complete technology & SaaS build is 6 weeks to 3 months. Phased programs run longer, with later phases added once the core build is adopted.

faq.question: Which systems do technology & SaaS builds integrate with?
faq.answer: The integrations that come up most often in technology & SaaS use cases are Jira, Zapier, Make, Salesforce, Tempo, Aircall API/webhooks.

faq.question: Does Fruition build AI agents for technology & SaaS?
faq.answer: Yes. 1 of the technology & SaaS use cases on this page include an AI step. Examples: AI call summaries and action-item extraction on every call.

useCases.title: Online utilities comparison platform (sales contact centre)
useCases.summary: A comparison-platform sales floor was moving off a legacy dialer and needed campaign-based routing, consistent dispositions, call QA and real-time call data flowing into its in-house CRM.
useCases.challenge: A comparison-platform sales floor was moving off a legacy dialer and needed campaign-based routing, consistent dispositions, call QA and real-time call data flowing into its in-house CRM.
boards: Campaign-based call queues across product verticals
IVR with AI intent-based routing across 10+ brand numbers
Disposition and tagging taxonomy by campaign
Dashboards for agents, team leaders, QA and operations (campaign KPIs, SLA)
QA workflow: evaluation triggers, coaching loop, dispute tracking
automations: AI call summaries and action-item extraction on every call
AI soft-skills scorecard with custom criteria for QA
Webhooks on call events (incoming, outgoing, missed, voicemail, tagged) to the in-house CRM
Answering machine → re-queue lead after a delay; not interested → suppression; missed inbound → callback task with 15-minute SLA; cross-sell → route to second campaign
useCases.outcome: A configured cloud telephony platform with AI intent routing, AI call summaries and QA scorecards, and webhook-driven CRM integration with re-queue, suppression and callback rules.

process.title: AI-routed sales calls with CRM sync and QA scorecards
